name: Banzai International, Inc. Class A Common Stock
description: Banzai International Inc is a Software as a Service (SaaS) company operating in the marketing technology (MarTech) industry. The group provides customers with tools to help them market and sell with greater efficiency and impact. Its customers include Amazon, Dell, Salesforce, Aflac, Thermo Fisher Scientific, RBC Wealth Management, Fitch Group, and many other brands. The Company has three reportable operating segments: Banzai Operating Co, Inc., OpenReel, and Vidello. Its segments deliver SaaS tools that leverage data, analytics, and AI to provide marketing and sales solutions, including video production and editing, for businesses of all sizes. Geographically, it operates in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA), and the Asia Pacific.
